goal: Unify folder hierarchy and file naming across all five repos: one written convention codified from the measured dominant styles and lint-enforced everywhere, per-repo target trees derived from the AD charters and layer contracts, and a real landing plan - per-repo migration waves as the final cleanup train with git-mv blame preservation, same-commit gate-config updates, public-specifier safety, and proven behavior neutrality.
nonGoals: No behavior, API, or contract changes - moves and renames only, proven behavior-neutral per wave.
No invented style: the convention codifies measured dominants; target trees follow the AD-written responsibility model.
No public specifier changes outside the SN0 wildcard-handling ruling (frozen until after SD-5 phase 2 by default).
No wave on a repo with any other in-flight demand; the Plugin wave additionally waits for CKG completion and the CC packaging demands.
No version bumps or releases without user direction.

Written convention artifact, SN5 rename plan, per-wave commit protocol, and frozen-path list produced under the recorded rulings
